summary: Yimutian Inc. filed a 6-K confirming completions: the Qingdao Xingongguan VIE acquisition of 100% equity for US$5,800,000 paid in 15,875,910,000 Class A shares (2,645,985 ADSs) to Ning and Kuili Zhang on September 10, 2026; the Zhaodong Guohe land, building and equipment asset purchase for US$21,161,390 paid via 57,923,514,000 Class A shares (9,653,919 ADSs); and, on September 20, 2026, the first-phase purchase of 33.33% of Qingdao Quanao from Aoge for US$25,000,000, issued at US$2.06 per ADS, implying US$75,000,000 for 100%. Watch heavy share issuance dilution, ADS overhang and optional remaining tranches.
